## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Architectural change / New Contract
- [ ] Performance optimization / Benchmark improvement
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the architectural guidelines of CnA Framework.
- [ ] I have run `php cna test` and all 34+ tests pass.
- [ ] I have run `php cna security:check` and all checks pass.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] If applicable, I have authored an ADR under `docs/adr/`.
